evaluation_basis: Assessed as a data-engineering and source-semantics stage; it was not designed to establish tradable alpha.
original_objective: Break the 1000-bar ceiling and build auditable futures, funding, basis, OI and taker-side order-flow ingestion.

engineering_result.summary: Gap-free CoinEx spot/futures histories, long funding history, computed basis, current OI and recent taker-side order flow were acquired with retry/audit behavior.

scientific_result.summary: Funding and same-venue basis became usable research inputs; the CoinEx basis-history endpoint was rejected as uninformative and historical OI/order flow remained unavailable through recent REST endpoints.

economic_result.summary: No alpha or profitability claim was part of v0.3.

limitations: Spot API history began in 2023-09 at 4h
Recent-deals order flow lacked historical depth
contribution_to_next_version: Enabled v0.4 point-in-time archive backfills and isolated feature-family ablations.
